content.text: You're a digital creator in Nigeria, locked out of Stripe and Gumroad, struggling to receive USDT payments in a timely manner. In other regions, PayPal's unpredictable fees and slow settlement times leave you frustrated. NowPayments' 0.5% fee structure and instant USDT payment verification on Tron and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solana-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-stripe|solana]] offer a better solution. With [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-2|Cloudflare R2]] Workers, you can set up a complete payment and delivery pipeline without relying on Stripe or Gumroad. In this guide, we'll walk you through deploying the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to receive [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments for your digital products.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Most payment platforms fail creators in emerging markets due to restrictive policies, high fees, and slow settlement times. NOWPayments' decentralized architecture and 0.5% fee structure solve these problems. With NOWPayments, you can receive USDT payments instantly on Tron and Solana, bypassing traditional payment gateways. This setup is perfect for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other regions with restricted access to Stripe, PayPal, and other payment platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Converting crypto to local currency is the operational step that determines whether crypto payments are practically useful for a creator in a restricted market. In Nigeria, the most established route is USDT to naira through Binance P2P or local exchanges including Patricia and Quidax. Rates are consistently within 2 to 5 percent of the parallel market rate. In Ghana, cedis conversion happens through Binance P2P and active local P2P communities. In Kenya, USDT to Kenyan shilling is available through M-Pesa integrations on several exchanges. Average conversion time across all these markets is 20 to 30 minutes.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to create a new Cloudflare Worker that listens for incoming webhooks from NOWPayments. You'll also need to configure your worker to send email notifications to your customers when their payments are processed. Furthermore, you'll need to set up a new Cloudflare Page to host your digital products and configure your worker to send delivery notifications to your customers when their products are delivered.
NOWPayments' 0.5% fee structure is a game-changer for digital creators in emerging markets.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live and process your first transaction, you'll need to deploy your Cloudflare Worker to your Cloudflare account and set up a new payment method in your NOWPayments account. You'll also need to configure your worker to listen for incoming webhooks from NOWPayments and send email notifications to your customers when their payments are processed. Once your worker is deployed, you can test your payment and delivery pipeline by processing a payment from a test account.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

To scale your infrastructure once it's running, you'll need to monitor your worker's performance and adjust your configuration as needed. You'll also need to set up logging and error handling to ensure that your worker can handle high traffic and errors. Additionally, you'll need to configure your worker to handle multiple payment methods and payment gateways to ensure that your infrastructure can scale with your business.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable and supports competitive local currency rates.
Instant USDT payments on Tron and Solana revolutionize the way you receive crypto payments.

If you're looking for a comprehensive payment and delivery solution, check out our Edge Commerce Stack ($197) that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our infrastructure solutions. Additionally, our complete builder kit is available for instant download, providing you with all the necessary tools to build a scalable and secure payment and delivery pipeline.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this infrastructure, follow these steps: Create a new Cloudflare project and set up a Cloudflare Page to host your worker. Install the NOWPayments library in your Cloudflare Worker project. Configure your worker to listen for incoming webhooks from NOWPayments. Set up a new payment method in your NOWPayments account. Configure your worker to send email notifications to your customers when their payments are processed. Deploy your Cloudflare Worker to your Cloudflare account. Test your payment and delivery pipeline by processing a payment from a test account.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

You can receive crypto payments for your digital products by setting up a new payment method in your NOWPayments account and configuring your Cloudflare Worker to listen for incoming webhooks from NOWPayments.
What is the 0.5% fee structure for NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions, making it a cost-effective solution for receiving crypto payments.
How do I convert Bitcoin to naira?
You can convert Bitcoin to naira using a peer-to-peer exchange like Binance Patricia or other reliable exchange services.
What is the transaction fee for USDT on Tron?
The transaction fee for USDT on Tron is under $0.10 per transaction, making it a fast and affordable solution for receiving USDT payments.
Can I use Solana for USDT payments?
Yes, you can use Solana for USDT payments, which has average transaction fees of fractions of a cent per transaction.
